sources.title: Enhancing lesion detection in automated breast ultrasound using ...
sources.snippet: Abstract The inherent variability of lesions poses challenges in leveraging AI in 3D automated breast ultrasound (ABUS) for lesion detection. Traditional methods based on single scans have fallen short compared to comprehensive evaluations by experienced sonologists using multiple scans.

sources.title: GitHub - daud-shah/Breast_Lesion_Segmentation_using_YOLO
sources.snippet: This project focuses on instance segmentation of breast ultrasound images using YOLOv8 and YOLOv11 models. The main goal is to detect and segment tumor regions accurately from ultrasound scans to assist in early diagnosis and medical research.
